items.name: Tourist plan
items.desc: For a holiday of up to 60 days. We check your e-visa application, your documents and your health paperwork before you submit.
includes: Document checklist: passport, photo, itinerary, accommodation proof
Yellow fever and Health Declaration reminders

items.name: Business plan
items.desc: For meetings and consultations. Adds an invitation-letter template, equipment and customs notes and a tax briefing.
includes: Invitation-letter template for your Ghanaian host

items.name: Property investor plan
items.desc: For buying or leasing land and property. Leasehold guide, due-diligence checklist and a process for finding a licensed Ghanaian lawyer. Lawyer fees are extra and are not ours.

items.name: Diaspora and returnee plan
items.desc: For people moving home or back. Guidance on residence paperwork and the Non-Citizen Ghana Card where it applies.

items.name: Student plan
items.desc: For study in Ghana. We explain the route, prepare your document list and point you to the right authority.

items.name: Remote worker plan
items.desc: Advice only. We explain what is and is not clear for working remotely, and where to get a licensed adviser's answer.

items.name: E-visa walkthrough
items.desc: A step-by-step guide to the online e-visa: what to prepare, what to answer, what to avoid.

items.name: First week in Ghana guide
items.desc: Money, SIM cards, taxis, power and safety for your first days.

items.name: Document review
